other_conditions: The startup must be recognized by DPIIT (Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade) and submit its certificate of recognition
Must submit Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs or Certificate of Registration from the Registrar of Firms of the respective state
Must have a hardware or software product or a process solution that is present in the market
Must hold all applicable trade‑specific registrations such as CE, FSSAI, MSME, GST, etc.
Should not have any default in the last three fiscal years (2019‑20, 2020‑21, 2021‑22) by the entity, its promoters or group entities

Must submit audited financial statements (balance sheet and profit & loss) for the last three fiscal years; if the startup is less than three years old, all available financial statements must be uploaded
Startups less than one year old without audited financials are exempt from the audited‑financials requirement
If audited statements for FY 2021‑22 are unavailable, provisional statements issued by Chartered Accountants may be submitted
The startup must not be completing 10 years of incorporation on or before 31 March 2024
benefits_summary: A cash prize of ₹10,00,000 per category and the opportunity for winners and finalists to present their solutions to public authorities and corporates, with priority access to national and international startup events.
documents_required: Certificate of Incorporation or Certificate of Registration from the Registrar of Firms
Audited financial statements (balance sheet and profit & loss) for the last three fiscal years
Provisional financial statements (if audited statements for FY 2021‑22 are unavailable)
Trade‑specific registration certificates (e.g., CE, FSSAI, MSME, GST)
